video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners what a common table expression is: a named first step inside one SQL query, using customer order totals

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained, then back out to show everything

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of a table or card draws itself, then the card fills in

table_rows_wipe.what: Each row of a table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

chip_wipe.what: A small label chip is revealed from left to right

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

step_arrow_draw.what: A violet arrow draws itself from the first step chip down to the second

steps_exit.what: The two step chips and the arrow fade away

query_typing_fast.what: The lines of the nested query are typed letter by letter

inner_mark_wipe.what: A lavender band spreads from left to right behind the inner query

query_line_out.what: A line of the query slides up and fades out

query_line_in.what: A new line of the query slides up into its place

name_pill_wipe.what: A lavender pill spreads from left to right behind the name 'totals' in the query

total_names_enter.what: The customer names fade in in the totals table, one after another

amount_chip_enter.what: A white chip with a violet outline fades in around an order's amount

amount_travel.what: The amount travels in a shallow arc from the orders table to its customer's row in the totals table

amount_chip_exit.what: The travelling amount fades out as it reaches the totals table

total_count.what: A customer's total counts up as each amount arrives

definition_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the lines of the query that define totals

definition_ring_exit.what: The outline around those lines fades away

final_mark_wipe.what: A lavender band spreads from left to right behind the last two lines of the query

test_band_enter.what: A violet outlined band fades in over the first row of the totals table

test_band_step.what: The violet band slides down from one totals row to the next

test_band_exit.what: The violet band fades away after the last row

check_draw.what: A violet check mark fades in beside a total that passes

total_dim.what: The totals row that fails fades from navy to pale gray

name_travel.what: The name of a customer who passes travels from the totals table down into the result table

step_badge_enter.what: A round violet badge with a step number fades in beside a line of the query

read_arrow_draw.what: A violet arrow draws itself down the left side of the query from step one to step two

totals_exit.what: The totals table, its check marks and its 'temporary' label fade away

result_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the result table
